claude.sample_unit: consecutive emergency and trauma NCCT examinations

links.outcome: Sensitivity/NPV and share of exams safely deprioritized in worklist using AI
links.effect: Collaborative system recovered every remarkable exam, 100% sensitivity and NPV, deprioritizing 18% (368/2001; 95% CI 17–20); standalone commercial detectors left 31 of 324 remarkable exams deprioritized.
links.quote: In contrast, the collaborative system recovered every remarkable examination at a threshold prespecified in the development cohort, achieving 100% sensitivity and NPV while deprioritizing 18% of examinations (368/2001; 95% CI, 17–20).

links.outcome: Commercial detector misses on exams outside their indications
links.effect: Standalone commercial detectors left 31 of 324 remarkable examinations deprioritized, including 16 target-disease false negatives and 15 outside their indications.
links.quote: In a retrospective multicenter external validation of consecutive emergency and trauma cohorts ( n = 2001), standalone commercial detectors left 31 of 324 remarkable examinations deprioritized, including 16 target-disease false negatives and 15 outside their indications.
